hunk_reviews.source_judgment: Optional nonempty typing should quietly deselect the old option when its displayed value differs, while requireSelection retains selection until dismissal. The literal original passes the option object to displayWith; the owned _getDisplayValue(selectedOption.value) correctly passes the value and matches both actual minimum source implementations. Diagnostic cases check mismatch, updated matching display, callback argument identity and required-selection retention. Preserve the original clear-then-type native baseline and add direct nonempty typing coverage.

Moving programmatic cleanup from the low-level display updater to the nullish actual model assignment avoids clearing valid0, false or empty displayed values. The source before/after variants demonstrate the intermediate falsey defect and its later correction; the owned method and both retained minimum peers pass all fourteen cases without a product change.

The two added upstream native regressions distinguish optional deselection from required retention after selecting and reopening. The current legacy optional test first clears the input, and the required test prepares only a programmatic model. Strengthen those existing scenarios with a real selection/reopen and direct nonempty typing while retaining every current assertion and named case. Actual native execution is outstanding.

decision: The complete two-file/three-hunk typing/reset change is present in the owned legacy trigger. Optional nonempty typing quietly deselects a selected option when its displayed value no longer matches; displayWith receives the selected option value, retaining the correction to the original intermediate object argument. Required selection remains selected while typing until choice or dismissal. Programmatic cleanup is keyed to a nullish model, preserving non-null falsy values. The strengthened existing native cases require required-selection retention/reset, direct nonempty typing with display callback identity and quiet deselection, and reactive selected-state cleanup. Current whole-method Forms/RxJS diagnostics support this source judgment; actual Angular DI/rendering, packed behavior and runtime/compiler/RxJS/peer floors remain separate mandatory executions.
source_protocol_scope: Complete patched owned, tagged, both retained minimum peer and original before/after prototype methods. Real FormControl value-accessor callbacks and RxJS closing/option-change streams; explicit synthetic panel/option/overlay receivers and controlled render notifications. Visibility, close teardown, focus/open eligibility, sizing, label, modal ownership and key-manager hooks are substituted. Constructors, field initializers, Angular rendering/DI, real DOM outside-click/geometry, packed artifact, runtime/compiler/RxJS/peer-floor execution are excluded.
